messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER - High error rate for HarborLane VPC auth (dedicated pool dhp-42). 5xx from auth-proxy to IdP JWKS endpoint. Impact: connections failing to establish (client tokens rejected). Paging oncall.
Taylor SRE: Acked. I'm oncall for the next 30m. what's the error pattern? full 5xx or jwt verify fail?
Alex Devex: seeing a spike of `502` and `504` from our auth-proxy to customer JWKS (https://idp.harborlane.internal/.well-known/jwks.json). Token validations failing with "kid not found" and intermittent upstream 500.
Priya Eng: possible key rotation on their IdP? Also noticed their TLS handshake to jwks endpoint failing from our side right after 02:13 UTC.
Taylor SRE: Pulling logs now. `kubectl -n private-dhp logs auth-proxy-7f8d -c proxy | grep jwks | tail -n 200` shows repeated `tls: certificate signed by unknown authority` from our side at 02:14:03 UTC.
Alex Devex: Customer mentioned they rotated CA certs yesterday. Could be their new chain missing an intermediate that our NodeCA doesn't trust for outbound mTLS.
Raj CS: I just pinged HarborLane SRE (oncall) — they're aware and said they rotated certs but rolled forward, not backward. They're investigating on their side and coordinating with IdP vendor.
Priya Eng: For immediate mitigation we can do two things: 1) fallback to cached JWKS for 5m to reduce customer impact, 2) enable a temporary allow-list for the specific tenant to skip upstream JWKS fetch (still validate locally cached keys). Which do we want?
Taylor SRE: Do both in sequence. Step 1 now: flip cache policy to serve stale JWKS for dhp-42. Config patch:
```
PATCH /v1/config/auth/cache
{"tenant":"dhp-42","jwks_ttl_allow_stale":300}
```
Taylor SRE: applied. deploy-bot: rolling config to auth-proxy (dhp-42) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: config rollout completed for auth-proxy/dhp-42 :white_check_mark:
Alex Devex: After the cache flip, upstream errors dropped but token verify still failing for new tokens with KID that isn't in cache.
Priya Eng: We'll need to force an immediate JWKS refresh once TLS fixed OR ask customer to publish the old key as a fallback key with a new kid. Raj, ask HarborLane to re-add previous KID temporarily.
Raj CS: HarborLane says they can re-publish previous JWKS entry within 15min. They also flagged their reverse proxy logs show 502 when our IP hits them due to SNI mismatch after their cert change.
Taylor SRE: SNI mismatch -> connection uses wrong hostname. Are we using the correct SNI? Our outbound client should set SNI as `idp.harborlane.internal`. Running tcpdump from proxy to check SNI: `tcpdump -n -s0 -A dst host 10.12.7.23 and port 443 | grep 'Server Name'`
Alex Devex: tcpdump shows SNI=`lb.harborlane.net` while we expect `idp.harborlane.internal`. That's their LB rewriting SNI. They need to present cert for that name or accept our SNI.
Priya Eng: Two customer-facing options:
- HarborLane update LB to present cert with `idp.harborlane.internal` CN/SAN
- We set outbound SNI override in tenant bridge for dhp-42 to `lb.harborlane.net` temporarily
Taylor SRE: I prefer outbound SNI override for fastest mitigation. Impact: small security surface increase but limited to one tenant and for a short window.
Raj CS: HarborLane approved SNI override if it gets them back online. They asked for an ETA.
Taylor SRE: Implementing SNI override now. Command:
```
POST /v1/tenants/dhp-42/bridge
{"outbound_sni":"lb.harborlane.net","sni_override_ttl":900}
```
Taylor SRE: applied. deploy-bot: updating tenant bridge for dhp-42 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: tenant bridge updated :white_check_mark:
Alex Devex: Retesting token validation. auth-proxy logs now show TLS handshake success and JWKS fetch 200. New tokens accepted. Passing load tests for dhp-42.
Taylor SRE: Marking incident as mitigated for user-facing auth failures. Still need follow-up: (a) ask HarborLane to fix LB cert chain and SNI behavior, (b) rotate back our override and remove stale cache, (c) postmortem for why SNI mismatch wasn't detected in canary.
Priya Eng: I'll own remediation item (c) with runtime team. We should add an outbound SNI test to our e2e for VPC tenants.
Raj CS: Noted — I'll coordinate with customer to confirm when they publish old KID and fix their LB chain. HarborLane will confirm within 2 hours.
Taylor SRE: Handoff to next oncall (Priya) in 15m. Key actions remaining: follow up on LB cert chain, remove SNI override once certs validated, ensure jwks cache TTL returned to default. Anyone else to notify?
Priya Eng: I'll update the incident board (INC-217900) and set severity to Sev2 with customer impact note: "Auth failures for subset of requests; temporary SNI override applied; no data loss." Will include timeline.
customer-harborlane: Thanks team — HarborLane will roll the old key to JWKS endpoint and push a cert chain fix. We'll update here when done.
Taylor SRE: Thanks all. Closing pager: please keep thread updated if HarborLane doesn't confirm full fix in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged and annotated with runbook delta: `sni-override` step recorded. Paging suppressed.
